label: Fires at D1 right after a rewarded rare a2->S1 trial.
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (belief < 0.5) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo
explanation: D1-only feature (zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude is set by the previous trial: about +1.3 above the timing baseline after a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded, and near zero after every other pattern. That one indicator gives dev R^2 0.66 beyond timing, against an all-cue ceiling of 0.75. The free fit adds a little (dev 0.69). Weaker firing after a1 -> S1 rewarded when the trial before was a2 or the observer belief favoured S2, so an S1 reward that was not expected. A small negative belief_lo slope inside the a2 S1 r cell means it fires less when S1 is already believed good. Future, hidden-state and since-reversal cues add almost nothing. Model outputs were not used.

issues: The claims hold. The short form (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S1 r') scores 0.658 test R^2 beyond timing, against an observed-only ceiling of 0.72. In the profile the D1 residual after a2 S1 r is +1.30, and after every other previous-trial pattern it is about -0.10 to +0.03. GO and D2 are exactly zero.

Misses on the short form show only small systematic errors. Predictions are about 0.09 too high at D1 after the non-firing patterns, which is a baseline offset. The largest under-prediction is D1 after a1 S1 r (+0.05 mean). Some windows fire strongly (about 1.0-1.6) through runs of rewarded a1->S1 trials, and no observed cue I tried captures these.

Adding firing after a1 S1 r when the trial before was a2 raises test R^2 only to 0.673. Using belief_lo < 0 as the condition gives 0.659, and tv('reward', -2) == 0 gives 0.662. So the free fit's 'unexpected S1 reward' extension is real but minor.

The declining strength inside the a2 S1 r cell is small: an a2 S1 r * belief_lo term reaches 0.671, and an a2 S1 r * ep_dec term reaches 0.674. A 3-term form with both extensions scores 0.689 (the free fit was 0.690). The ep_dec term is a timing-style correction, not a better description, so the one-cue short form remains the right interpretation.
